propositions: A class with an unreachable primary model should fall back to a configured fallback model, constructed from inline model configs using pydantic-ai's FallbackModel wrapper

The fallback trigger condition must be narrowed to provider-fixable errors (rate limits, timeouts, connection failures) rather than firing on all exceptions, to avoid masking credential or input-size problems
Fallback entries carrying custom endpoints must be honored during model construction, not silently replaced with provider defaults
Capabilities must be computed as the conservative intersection over all candidates (primary and fallbacks) before the FallbackModel wrapper is built, not inferred from the wrapper's missing profile
The ran_model field must be sourced from the response's ModelResponse.model_name, not the synthetic FallbackModel.model_name, to correctly attest which candidate actually answered
The FallbackModel must be used as an async context manager so that all sub-model providers are entered and exited, while rebar-created transports remain managed by ProviderSession._closeables
